name: Special South Gate City Council
minutes_text:
CITY  OF SOUTH  GATE
  SPECIAL  CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING
  MINUTES
  TUESDAY,  MARCH  25, 2025

CALL  TO ORDER  Maria  Davila,  Mayor  called  a Special  City  Council  Meeting  to order  at
  5:30 p.m.

ROLL  CALL  Yodit  Glaze,  City  Clerk

PRESENT  Mayor  Maria  Davila,  Vice Mayor  Joshua Barron,  Council  Member  Gil
  Hurtado  and Council  Member  Al Rios;  City Treasurer  Jose De La Paz,
  City  Manager  Rob Houston,  Special  Counsel  Jerry Ruiz

ABSENT/EXCUSED  Council  Member  Maria  del Pilar Avalos,  City Attorney  Rail  F. Salinas

1

CERTIFICATES  The City  Council  presented  Certificates  of Appreciation  to the Aztecs  AU
  Cheer for winning  Ist Place at the 2025 JAMZ  Youth  National
  Championships  in Las Vegas, Nevada  and South  Gate Aztecs  6U Flag
  Football  for winning  the 2024 AAU  Division  2 Super
  Bowl  Championships  in San Bernardino,  CA.

2

CERTIFICATES  The City  Council  presented  a Certificate  of Appreciation  to Jovanna
  Laborin  in recognition  of her service  as Planning  Commissioner  and
  longtime  community  volunteer.

3
PF,RSONNEL  RECRUITMENT

& SELECTION  The City  Council  received  and filed  the list of new and promoted  full-time
  employees  hired  or promoted  during  February  2025.

RECESS  At this time,  5:58 p.m.,  Mayor  Davila  stated that the special  meeting  be
  recessed  in order that the Council  might  hold its 5:35 p.m. Housing
  Authority  meeting.  The special  meeting  reconvened  at 6:10 p.m. with  four
  (4) Council  present.
   SPECIAL  CITY  COUNCIL  MEETING  MINUTES  OF MARCH  25, 2025

CLOSED  SESSION  The Council  Members  recessed  into Closed  Session  at 6:11 p.m. and
  reconvened  at 6:39 p.m. with  four  (4) Members  of Council  present.

  Special  Counsel  Ruiz  reported  the following:

  1.  CONFERENCE  WITH  LABOR  NEGOTIATOR
  Pursuant  to Government  Code Section  54957.6

  Agency  Representation:  Rob Houston,  City  Manager

  Unrepresented  Employees:  Top Management/Department
  Directors
  Hourly  Employees

  Employee  Organizations:  SGMEA,  SGPMMA,  SGDMA,
  SGPMA,  SGPOA

  On item 1, there was no reportable  action  taken.

ADJOURNMENT  Vice Mayor  Barron  adjourned  the meeting  at 6:40 p.m. and
  seconded  by Council  Member  Rios.

PASSED  and APPROVED  on this  22ndday ofApril  2025.

  ATTEST:

  Yodit  laze, City  Clerk
